notes: Today's show is a special Sponsor Insight from Aumni, highlighting their growing business for venture capitalists, operators, and LPs. Aumni helps private capital investors track and analyze individual deal terms, while providing comprehensive financial and legal insights across portfolios and the broader venture market. I sat down with Kelsey Chase, the Founder and President at Aumni, to discuss his background as a lawyer and the creation of Aumni, how Aumni analyzes transaction data, and use-cases of this data for investors and operators. We also discuss Aumni's recent series B round, trends in venture arising from Aumni's database, and where Kelsey plans to take the company from here. We are incredibly grateful to Aumni for sponsoring our Venture is Eating the Investment World mini-series, and we are eager to highlight their value to the venture and investment community.  Kelsey Chase – Analyzing Venture Transactions at Aumni (Capital Allocators, EP.241) Mar 17, 2022

 Today’s show is a special Sponsor Insight from Aumni,
highlighting their growing business for venture capitalists,
operators, and LPs. Aumni helps private capital investors track and
analyze individual deal terms, while providing comprehensive
financial and legal insights across portfolios and the broader
venture market. 
 

I sat down with Kelsey Chase, the Founder and President at Aumni,
to discuss his background as a lawyer and the creation of Aumni,
how Aumni analyzes transaction data, and use-cases of this data for
investors and operators. We also discuss Aumni’s recent series B
round, trends in venture arising from Aumni’s database, and where
Kelsey plans to take the company from here. 
 

We are incredibly grateful to Aumni for sponsoring
our  Venture is Eating the Investment
World  mini-series, and we are eager to highlight their
value to the venture and investment community.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
